newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - November 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - November 26.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Tuesday's edition of Daily Variety:
HOLLYWOOD - MCA TV Group of Seagram Co Ltd has agreed to buy from Gannett Co Inc all the assets of its talkshow syndicator, Multimedia Entertainment, for about $45 million.

HOLLYWOOD - Sony Corp's Sony Pictures Entertainment has dismissed Columbia TriStar Motion Picture Cos President Fred Bernstein. It apparently does not have any plans to replace him. His former duties will be split by Columbia TriStar Vice Chairwoman Lucy Fisher and Executive Vice President Gareth Wigan.

WASHINGTON - The Federal Communications Commission is on track to bless a digital TV standard by the New Year after computer, broadcaster and consumer electronics officials reached an agreement in principle Monday on controversial elements of the proposal.
